fact: The Civil Registration Code as revised by Law 12/2018 established the e-SIRCEV electronic system, said to be integrated with the national ID and health systems (CRVS Law and Policy Compendium).

Jornal Notícias reports that people registered in the Nacala birth campaign can have the Bilhete de Identidade issued on the spot from the electronic data the registrar captured, through interoperability of the two services.
system: registo de nascimento / Bilhete de Identidade interoperability
